meta.name: finishing-a-development-branch
meta.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work

copy.tagline: 帮你决定开发分支的集成方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成功能开发并准备把代码合并到主分支
copy.tagline_en: Decide how to integrate your completed development work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have finished implementing a feature and need to merge your branch

howto.what: 开发完成后,它先跑完整测试套件;测试通过再识别你的 Git 环境(普通仓库、worktree、detached HEAD),列出集成选项菜单,等你选定后执行本地合并、推送建 PR 或保留分支,并按规则清理工作区。
howto.when: 当实现已完成、所有测试通过,需要决定如何把这部分工作合并进主线时触发。测试不通过则只报告失败并停下,不给选项。

say.text: 实现做完了、测试也过了,帮我决定这个分支怎么合并
say.note: 它会先跑测试套件,再列出集成选项

say.text: 这个功能分支完成了,给我整合方案选项
say.note: 本地合并、推送建 PR、保留分支三选一

say.text: 把当前分支本地合并到基线分支
say.note: 合并后会在合并结果上重跑测试

howto.what_en: After implementation, it runs the full test suite; if green, it detects your Git environment (normal repo, worktree, detached HEAD) and lists integration options. Once you choose, it merges locally, pushes for a PR, or keeps the branch, then cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggers when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work. If tests fail, it reports the failures and stops.

say_en.text: Implementation is done and tests pass - help me decide how to integrate this branch
say_en.note: It runs the test suite first, then shows options

say_en.text: This feature branch is finished, give me integration options
say_en.note: Merge locally, push a PR, or keep as-is

say_en.text: Merge the current branch into the base branch locally
say_en.note: It re-runs tests on the merged result
